summary: Kilo listed Tencent: Hy3 (free) at $0.00 per 1M input and output tokens, and its 2026-07-06 blog post said Hy3 was totally free for a limited time everywhere you use Kilo, with high limits thanks to compute from Novita. As of 2026-11-16 the free model has ended: Kilo's live gateway returns HTTP 404 model_not_found for tencent/hy3:free and its model list carries only the paid tencent/hy3. The kilo.ai model page still says the model is available at no cost, but the newer live API response is used. No official end date was announced.
claim_steps: Open Kilo (Kilo Code or another Kilo surface)
Select Tencent Hy3 from the model dropdown

social_proof.title: From Preview to Production: Tencent's Hy3 Model Has Arrived
social_proof.text: Hy3 is totally free for a limited time everywhere you use Kilo, with high limits thanks to compute from Novita. Just select Tencent Hy3 from the model dropdown wherever you use Kilo.

social_proof.title: Authentication
social_proof.text: The gateway allows unauthenticated access for free models only. Anonymous requests are identified by IP address and are subject to rate limiting (200 requests per hour per IP).

social_proof.author: Kilo (acq. by Anaconda)
social_proof.text: FREE AI CODING MODEL ALERT! @TencentHunyuan's latest model, HY3, is now FREE in Kilo Code for a limited time. Here are the one-shot results when we prompted Opus, Fable, and HY3 to "Create a 3D HTML visualizer of Earth spinning in space" in Kilo's Agent Manager

social_proof.title: Kilo Gateway models API
social_proof.text: 469 models listed on 2026-11-16; Tencent entries are tencent/hy3 (prompt 0.000000132, completion 0.000000528, discount 0), tencent/hy3-preview, tencent/hy4, tencent/hy4-flash and others — no tencent/hy3:free. Requesting tencent/hy3:free returns HTTP 404: "The requested model 'tencent/hy3:free' does not exist."
